“I always leave you free to do what you believe is right, I approve of everything, don’t worry my dear, I assure you that I am happy.”160

“I hear with pressure all the things that you told me regarding the hospital; I only feel sad to hear that you are awake till late hours my dear, this makes me feel concerned about your health. Promise me that you will not do this any longer.”161

The Mother knew the weakness of her Daughters. Her loving strength revitalized them and she encouraged them to develop their ability to have self-determination. She recognized every possibility for development and for achievement in each nun.

Sr. Francesca Camisa did not feel that she was able to manage the administrative accounting work because she received very little preparation for this kind of work. With kind severity, M. Rosa liberated her from a confused evaluation of her possibilities.

“As far as the financial records are concerned, I tell you that you must do everything. You will succeed in keeping accurate records. You can work well without help, you just have to be careful, you write very well and when you don’t know something, you can consult the dictionary.”162

M. Rosa gave her nuns the security that they needed to overcome psychological tensions and the lack of confidence, she offered herself with a clear conscience as “water of peace” She sent this message to Sr. Carlotta Biagini whose feelings were hurt by a fellow nun, who was not prudent and insensitive.:

“We are not infallible but weak human creatures, and if the Good Lord would not hold us with His right hand, we would perish. Be happy don’t become upset, because I know that much sorrow is caused by these events. Finally, my dear Daughter, you did well in writing to me immediately, the source may provide peaceful water for you.”163

To the same Sister she had written this message a few months before:

“My Daughter, yesterday I received your letter: I am replying to console you in your problems. My dear, be happy because the devil is the enemy of our good works; he would like to distract us from doing them in order to agree with his desires that are of eternal damnation. No, no my Carlotta must be with me in Paradise to enjoy, so that we will always be united to Him; Love our Good Lord Jesus.”164

With friendly closeness, she gave encouragement to a positive life and to good intentions. She raised her life above the level of pettiness of peace beyond “vague ideas”, towards the wonderful promise of peace that came from the source; magnanimity and patience were developed and strengthened. Her life was simple dedication, an expression of mercy that was naturally acquired by contact with the mystery of God. She accepted the burden of sorrows. She wrote to Sr. Virginia Gaggi, on 17,2. 1892 (Sr. Virginia Gaggi was then in America)

“You say that I don’t feel compassion for your illness, what can I do or say? I can only ask Jesus to give me all your sorrows and to allow you to work peacefully in the Holy Institute!”

In the situations of absurd sorrow such as serious illness and the premature death of young Sister, she wept and prayed. The deep wound received in her heart remained and she warned the other Daughters to prevent illness, she begged them to be careful about their health. To Francesca Camisa who had delicate heath, she gave this advice:

“For goodness sake, look after your health, because if I hear that you are ill, it will be the greatest sorrow for me. I hear that you are not feeling well; I am asking you to look after your health, not to worry, not to become angry, you must eat great quantity of healthy food. Try to eat an egg at breakfast. Finally look after your health, it’s precious: I understand that I have lost it.”165

To Sr. Vincenza Rapallino she sent this message:

“If you wish to do the most wonderful thing in the world for me, you must take care of your health.”166

My Daughter, do not exhaust yourself, take care of your health because in fifteen days, you will be here in Rome.”167

This urgent advice was addressed to Sr. Adelaide Pezzoni, who was experiencing problems due to her rehabilitation after suffering an illness. Four days later, M. Rosa suggested that she should follow a very precise procedure.

“My Daughter I advice you not to eat salty foods and I give you permission to tell when you don’t like that specific food. So you may ask to make a nourishing type of soup; it would also be good for your health, if you begin to drink goat’s milk or if you could drink donkey’s milk, it would be even better. Do everything very quietly… I wish that you will follow all of my advice.

” M. Rosa could not accept certain choices that her Daughters made to become over-workers: She sent this message to one nun:

“I am disgusted with you because you work too hard and others also work too hard, you endanger your health. You could not hire a servant to do some very hard types of work?168

“I hear all the things you have told me about the hospital (in Genova), I am very sad to hear that you go to sleep too late, my dear this makes me worry about your health; promise that you will not do this any longer, leave everything.”169

A few days later, (on March 6th), She again insisted and emphasized the same message to Sr. Camisa:

“I give all faculties to you, I will approve of everything that you do; I only will not approve and I will always be contrary on neglecting your health. Oh! I feel so consoled when you tell me that you are in good health. Yes, my dear, make sure that you don’t work too hard, take care of yourself, then you will be my consolation.”

There were different types of illness that upset M. Rosa. Having trained herself in the spiritual discipline of “complete service”, she wished to involve her Daughters in her method of decision, strength and loyalty. She loved to know that they were following “the same spiritual way.” Because of her extraordinary intuition she was clearly aware of the pettiest lack of love among her nuns: their inclination to indulge in vanity a certain sense of complacency… petty and insignificant faults. For her who had experienced “the crazy love of God”, these were ties, poison that could sadden and extinguish love. She was an enlightened conscience, a herald of truth; she used benevolence, goodness, respect for others feelings, as a mother she reprimanded others in a gentle manner. She wished that her nuns would experience all the liberating love of their Mother. A letter written to Sr. Eletta Bruschi on 11.7.1873 gives a vivid picture of this pleasant spiritual family.

“Today my dear Eletta, you may allow me to tell you something about the visits that you received from the ladies of Tor De Specchi. I am telling you this, not to admonish you, but only as your very affectionate Mother, who holds you close to the heart of Jesus, to the glory of heaven where no sorrows will reign, or worries, but only eternal joy. I would like that when you speak to these young ladies, you may always express constructive thoughts (I am certain that you always do this); I repeat, you must understand that my advice is an idle thought and you must allow me to express it because I am your Mother and you know that mothers are always having high ambitions for their children; they will see them as the saints, yet they know that they are never happy about their holiness: your Mother is like them; the reason that I say these things is that whatever you will say will be noted and consequences will derive from it. Therefore take care, make sure that your words will be constructive and never reply to mundane questions. My dear Eletta, we must be concerned only to serve God. We leave the rest to worldly people. If you knew what has happened to a superior who allowed herself to carelessly speak about clothes. My God! You can’t imagine what happened. But I have said enough: I see that I am becoming confused, I write comments that are irrelevant for you. My Daughter let us talk about our own subjects, let us talk about our dear Jesus who keeps us in His love. Yes my God, I wish my Eletta to be consumed in Jesus’ wounded side. My dear, pray that we may receive everything by prayer; prayer provides all our benefits.

Oh! Prayer is an endless source of grace, my Eletta, let us go to drink from this source, the water of health and of life. You asked for news about the house (situated in Morte street). But what can I tell you about the house? I am oppressed by too much work and I can’t go beyond this point. I am completely yours.

Your affectionate M. Rosa.”

When evil subtly enters not only the heart of one person is in danger, but also becomes a scandal for the “little children”; her “sorrow” becomes “maximum” Before she could see with a clear conscience sin as an offence and as a lack of respect for the “Person of Jesus”. M.Rosa was forced, regretfully to speak a language that is certainly new.

“Until now I have always wished to accept responsibility for everything, but as this is not sufficient for your soul, consider that you must do penance for your sins and make restitution for the disrespect that you have shown towards God…Don’t come tomorrow because I will be absent and I don’t know when I will be back. So I believe that it is your duty to help those unfortunate persons, whom the very Merciful Lord has entrusted to your care. Let us not worry, instead, let us think seriously and with discretion. It is time for work and for great sorrow in this work of the Lord. The church is troubled therefore all that belongs to it is experiencing sorrow and trouble.” 170

The final liberating blow freed the universal horizons. It was now possible for the nuns to live with greater honesty. The Daughters, even though when they were reprimanded, they understood their Mother’s strong love.

“I wish that my reprimands should be understood as a motherly kind of love, not as a punishment.” 171

She was a Mother who had received an unusual mission to help the Daughters of St. Anne grow, by helping them to imitate the example of the Holy Mother, the most merciful women, an example that M. Rosa herself imitated. M. Rosa wished to teach them by “precise observance of the Rules”, in learning the “typical virtues”, which nourishes their souls. She wished them to be a holy generation; she did not deviate from this task.

“You must often remind yourselves of the reason why you became nuns: to become holy. Therefore if you wish, read often your Rules, and endeavour to record them in your heart and in your mind and always observe them. God will help you to practice the Rules and by following them, you will become saints.” 172

Mother Rosa wished that each nun should follow the principle that inspired the Rules, that was love, the gift of the Father, in Christ, with the help of the Holy Spirit. It was important for her nuns to accept every little observance with passionate love, as a mysterious and irresistible appeal to respond with little gestures of love to the immense love of the Crucified Christ. 173

Dear Daughter, I very much regret that I must for the first time tell you certain things that you should interpret as warnings and as corrections, all for the sake of your soul. Dear Jesus how much you suffer if one of your brides rejects your love while you suffer during these days. (It was carnival time). Daughters are you telling me that your heart does not still feel love for your beloved and Good Jesus? Do you know who has led you into this condition? Our sins; Therefore, during these days Jesus feels so sad. Now I see one of your brides so ironically suggests to deviate from that petty abstinence, that your dear Mother St. Anna wrote in the Rules of her Daughters, the abstinence from eating meat during the last two days of Carnival and the offering of some minor sorrows. To be honest when I heard the superior reading that brief note, which contained certain expressions that concerned me, I shuddered. My God, has this Daughter seen her poor Mother deviating from the pettiest of the Rules? With God’s help I am and I will be very strict and I will never make the smallest concession. I hope that you have not eaten meat, and I would be very unfair if the community has deviated from these rules, because of your bad example. So, then let us admit that everything was done inadvertently and let us hope that it will not happen again. I assure you that on the second day, I feel very ill; I feel so weak; this was a bitter pill that I had to swallow; have very willingly accepted and offered to the Eternal Father as a penance for the suffering of His Divine Son.

Goodbye, Your poor Mother Rosa now and for all eternity.”

She felt so much sorrow, and regret for the offence to the Lord and for her Daughter who had committed a sin. She could not approve of a mistake. However she did not condemn the Daughter. For the offence that she suffered, she only had words of sorrow: “I shuddered…” “A bitter pill…” She experienced the feelings of Christ. Like Christ she offered love. It was a love that forgives; a mother’s love that was wounded by “a bitter pill”; but responded with the mildness of forgiveness and with an effort to achieve a stronger mutual love. To another Daughter she said:

“You ask me to forgive you; I forgive you not once but a hundred times. And if the superior reprimands you, it is done for your own good, not for any other reason. But always I keep you close to the heart of Jesus and I say many prayers for you; if you improve your behaviour, you would certainly receive God’s grace.” 174

By considering the Mother’s good example, the Daughters felt moved to follow her; they completely trusted her as a reliable guide and as a teacher of holiness. In February 1867, she sent this message to M Rosa, Caterina Rapallino, who was one of M. Rosa’s first followers:

“God gave you to me as a helper and as a guide to show me the way to heaven, to take me away from the illusion which I experienced, to become more closely united with you.”

Rosa’s words provided answers to the most serious questions; they clarified the conscience of one’s vocation as they were enriched by the great abundance of her wise love. When it began, the new Family did not offer any guarantee of stability. This could have led some parents to doubt the future of that Family. However the Daughters believed that everything would be easy because their leader was a wise leader leading as on eagle’s wings; she could see from above the future of the Family and the events that shaped its present, in an essential objective way. Her mere presence inspired trust, order, good management, and harmony, among all nuns. Her absence created a void in authority and other problems. The Foundress did not allow herself to be overwhelmed by passing events. She was called to intimacy of the complacent “revision” she was called to works of charity and the “propagation of faith.”

During 1866, she established and organized the first community in Piacenza. In February 1867, she went to Cento (Ferrara), with eight postulants, to establish a second community, near the hospital of that City. The Daughters in Piacenza waited for her everyday. As they wished that she should be with them they were wandering by her late arrival.

The “wise” Mother is not based on milk and honey. She wanted her nuns to be solid, secure, authentic and free. On February 18, 1867, she sent her reply to them:

“You have told me that you have waited for me everyday my dear Daughters, how could that have been possible, when in so few days one does not know even the place of things in the house... Therefore, let us not have any illusions; in the Works of the Lord we need patience and sacrifice; God prefers sacrifices more that great promises and anything else. Jesus sacrificed Himself for us and He drank the bitter chalice until his last day on earth; while we feel so sad because we are separated. Ah! Come now my children, let us abandon our baby clothes (these are used for babies who can’t walk without help), and let us then throw ourselves into the bosom of the Eternal Father, let us ask Him to carry out with us his will.”

However, the Daughters’ message deeply touched her. How could she fail to understand their concerns? She tried to console them with kind and persuasive words. On February 20 1867, she wrote to Giovanna Bixio:

“.. My dear child be brave, do not disappoint me because I feel so bad when I hear that you are sad… I will come to see you as soon as I can, and I will be in your arms and you in mine; it will always be as the Lord commands.”

When she left Cento, her Daughters who were left alone with their increasing difficulties of their everyday life, repeated their cry for help to their Mother. M. Rosa was concerned, patient and understanding, she did not merely offer words and gestures of consolation but she retuned to help them.

“Stop weeping, on Sunday I will be with you… I am not saying anything else to you because time will not allow me to do so.”

She hurried to advice them; she provided hope for the waiting period. And she told them:

“Believe me, your Mother blesses you and holds you all close to her bosom, she will never leave you, I am always yours.”175

In another message she wrote:

“My Daughters, I assure you that I am dying from the desire to be with you to participate in your charity. Yes, I hope that it will happen soon, this makes me work during day and night, in order to work near the persons whom I love so much, those who are ill and you my Daughters.”176

“Yesterday I received your dear letters, I assure you that they were a real consolation and they made me laugh and I needed to laugh… I will come to you as soon as I can… I have sent you a sack of potatoes and a basket of pears, I wish that you will eat all the fruits, don’t give it to others.” 177

The “requests” of her Daughter, reinforced the Mother’s compassion and mercy, benevolence, and tenderness became stronger in her heart. She replies the questions asked by Sr. Vincenza Rapallino:

“It is true that we are separated, but what do you expect, do you believe that I am made of marble and do not feel this, but if we do everything for Jesus all our separation vanishes and we find ourselves always united. You tell me that I seem to be close to you, yes, my dear. Spiritually I am always with you and you may live securely. Be cheerful my dear, the one whom we serve is a Good Father. He is a very faithful Husband; He is incapable of being unfaithful Husband we must not fear.”178

As the number of the Daughters increased, M. Rosa’s gift of love was extended, opening itself to the immense dimensions of the “Being of her life”, of the reality of the Following of Jesus, “carrying the Cross close to her heart”. She sent this message to Sr. Paola Bucciotti on 29. 10.1873:

My Daughter, I have received your letter and I am sure that you feel very sad, and I am very sorry about this, I would like to take all your sorrows away; I wish that I could add your sadness to mine. I hear that some Sisters are ill, and I feel very sad about this, we do everything for the Lord. You see my dear, this is the only real way to reach Paradise: and to be near our God. Dear Daughter, for Jesus everything that we do is little. Be brave, do not allow yourself to be overwhelmed, consider we are on the Cross-, because our inheritance is the Cross that we have accepted. We do what we can, the rest depends on God.”

The love that the Daughters felt for her, even though it is expressed by “deeds” it is “proved” in the love of God, and it is confirmed, through strength and the loyalty that mean staying with Christ on the Cross. This was the pedagogical system used by Rosa Gattorno to establish her relationships with her Daughters. She expressed this in many different ways and she did not cease to repeat it.

“You tell me many times and with your actions you have proved to me your true love for me. I am very grateful to you for this; my dear, but how happy I would be, if you confirmed this by providing evidence that you experience for God a greater love. I assure you that the happiness would be great relief for my worries; then, come with me to Calvary for the love of our Crucified Lord, to be with Him alone; and together, with Him on the Cross.” 179

4.3 In the community-family of the Holy Mother of Mary

The New Religious Family that the Father had inspired in the Field of the Church was a part of His plan of salvation, of uniting the whole human race into one family, reunited in the name of Christ. This community was distinctive sign in the Church as a community lived permanently in a Eucharistic and liturgical way of life that was offered to the Father in Christ for the Spirit, and while waiting for the fulfilment, it hastened the coming of Christ in the hearts of all brothers and sisters, with a charitable spirit. Its distinctive sign was charity that united everyone in “one heart”. From the beginning, the Foundress clearly expressed the characteristics of the Family: “One heart and one thought alone, one aspiration alone, at the Centre, to serve God.” The wonderful unity of “one hundred persons, who act as one person” was a gift from God. The Daughters always will bless that “very Holy Hand that with so much benevolence and charity keeps them united as one family.” 180 They will develop gratitude and love for the Family that spiritually help them grow as Daughters of St. Anne;

“I wish that they would remember where they were spiritually born and that the Family is their true home and everyone should focus their love towards the Family.”181

As an experienced mother of a family, Rosa had the wisdom to create the supportive structures, so that the community environment would develop a family climate that would be cheerful, ordered and harmonious. First of all she prepared a Chapel.

“Now that the Chapel is established we can say that we have a House of the Daughters of St. Anne.”182

At this time I am in Genoa and I am taking this opportunity to write to you, so that you may have time to do the tasks that need to be done. You should paint the guest’s room and especially the kitchen, which is always so dirty. Make sure that all the copper utensils are cleaned. This house in Sampierdarena looks like a drawing room, because it is so clean. Yesterday I showed this house to a friend, she told me that it is so well organized! I know that this house is all in marble and is shining as a mirror. There is now a tap of water flowing with strength. Let us hope that the Lord will send everything that we need. He must provide everything! To us only confusion and.”183

Her knowledge of the positive progress made by the community consoled M. Rosa.

“I have visited the two houses in Sampierdarena, and in Genova, I can only tell you that I have discovered that there is great harmony and order there; it is a real consolation to live in those communities. The same here in the main house and the house in Morte Street; I can say that everything is going rather well. You, more than anything else must provide a good example, because you were the new member of the new foundation and because you are protected so well by the providence.” 184

In the familiar climate of happiness and harmony, the Daughters of St. Anne are mobilized to believe in the Spirit of Jesus Christ and to practice the characteristics of the first Christian community.

“Pray and love one another with one love and try to achieve that unity of thought and of action, (so that) all of you may form only one heart, only one thought, so that all of you are oriented towards the Centre that is God.” 185

A love that has these characteristics open positively room among the Sisters, for the mutual gift of friendship in the common convergence towards one’s own interior Centre in the important encounter with God and towards the same goal. Each Sister’s personal growth is considered a gift to one another in the community and is commitment towards an active service of charity. To be helping one another in understanding and in forgiveness. To enter in the process of conversion in the newness of life, that becomes a true gift and clear witnessing: “look how they love each other” It is not necessary to make sensational gestures to demonstrate this. Life itself speaks and announces the cohesion and the mutual love through simple gestures, through a climate that is based on mutual love.

M. Rosa developed the communal unity of the Daughters emphasizing the important of simple gestures. With the understanding and the perception of a mother, that is giving to every person a wholeness of affection and a joy of welcoming, opening the person to a dimension of fraternal love, in a common gift of attention and love. Here is a quotation from one of her letters:

“I will probably send Sr. Maria Vincenza so that she may accompany the others. Make sure that she receives all the attention that she deserves as she is still so young that you may be together and do everything for Saint Anne, the Mother of the Immaculate; allow yourself to be helped and rest, I am sending her precisely for this purpose.”186

The Sister that she entrusted to the care of the other Sister is young not as far as her age being of the same age with Sr. Francesca, but as far as her religious life was concerned she had received the habit of the Daughters of St. Anne only thirteen days before this letter was written.

A similar principle was relevant for Adelaide Pezzoni, who suffered from delicate health she needed more than suitable and healthy food, love and maternal understanding. M. Rosa entrusted her to the superior of the community in Ferrara, Sr. A Carlotta Biagini:

“My dear Daughter, I am only writing a brief message to tell you that the teacher is now in better health so you must feed her properly. She loves you very much, and she only wishes to know if you are happy, if you love her, and if her progress pleases you. Believe me my Daughter, I see that the Sister is very affectionate towards you, and only wishes to satisfy all your wishes. May God be blessed! What a great consolation I feel to know that there is peace among you. My God keep it among you and me, poor as I am I pray God to increase it for you every day.” 187

Fraternal charity according to a saying of Mother Rosa that unites everyone in one heart is a gift from God. This gift is developed through prayer, by using the source of divine grace, and it is expressed in the reality of the gift of oneself, everyday, in a process of unification of the differences in one unity.

“One sole heart”. “One sole thought” is placed in the context of a community that is a reflection and an anticipation of the Trinitarian dimension of community life. This gift is “already” developed in the mystery of the presence of Christ, He is a gift from the Father, and reveals to us and helps us to love in each person of the community “the sister”. He allows us to understand that only by grace we are called to be part of the Family of St. Anne, a shelter of peace, happiness, joy, acceptance and forgiveness.

But this is “not yet”. The natural weakness and littleness of the persons, who are called to follow this ideal, create limit and barriers to the flow of love. Selfishness is always active for obstructing the unity of intention. M. Rosa was the constant guardian; she did everything to ensure that each community might be a Family of the Holy Spirit, and that the community would live according to its Spirituality. She often exhorts, she clearly indicates the attitudes, the methods and the means that are necessary to develop and to strengthen the fraternal communion in the faithfulness of the Holy Rules. In a talk to a group of nurses who were sisters, M. Rosa strongly condemned the lack of fraternal charity:

“Tell me where is the charity that teaches us that Jesus who is a living example of Charity? We must imitate Him by never observing the faults of our fellow Sisters; if anyone did wrong it was because of distraction.”

Her zeal, her hard work in continual trying of helping the Family of the Holy Mother in the community are witnessed by a Letter written to Naples to a Community that is not known its name and its location.

The beautiful letter speaks for itself: In this letter is evident St. Paul’s passion to end the divisions among the Christians in Corinth and the bitterness of her maternal heart deep wounded by the wrong behaviour of the Daughters:

“Dear Daughters, I would like to say a few words in the name of the Lord, may these words be engraved in your hearts; and I don’t know where else I may find than in the Most holy Heart of the Love of Jesus. Daughters have pity and listen to me, I a mother who is speaking to you, these are words of that most sweet heart that expresses its kindness by speaking through your miserable and unworthy Mother, so listen to these message.

First He exhorts you to listen to Him with charity that is the source of love and He calls you in the name of peace and he wishes that the same charity may reign in you, all loving each other, being united in one person, your Mother Superior.

Peace be with you and may the Spirit of charity be revived. May the evil one the monster of complaining, be crushed; Evil spirit, I curse you!

I order you to live alone the person who don’t belong to you that is my very dear community, those are my Daughters. The Blood of God has taken them away from a corrupt world and He has placed them under His protection they are now his army, they fight under his banner.

Oh! Evil one, you are detested by the daughters of Zion, run away, I curse you!

Oh my Daughters! This name makes me weep because I know that there is division among you.

You Blessed Daughter of the Lord, you who know having it, tremble in your heart and bring at the feet of the Lord the triumph of your victory. Your heart may reject this evil monster, the Devil.

Ah! Promise me that you will change your way of life: you must return from impurity to purity and may your thought be one united with mine: worn yourself out for Jesus.

Be my comfort in these moments of fatigue and of sacrifice with one your letter where you assure me that you will practice what I advice you to do, in the mean time I hold you close to the very loving heart of my Jesus and I tell you that I am feeling great pain when I think of you. Have mercy on me, and tell me that you will convert your hearts and when I will visit you, I will find you as I wish you to be, all filled with love where I hope to see you all for Jesus.

Your very sorrowful Mother Sr. A. Rosa Gattorno.”

The strong reprimands condemn the evil in the community, and denounced its source. However the strength of the spirituality and of maternal feelings in which is expressed is the pedagogy of a living teaching of forgiveness. It is also an effusion of compassion, with the same measure of the heart of Christ towards the creatures of her Heart. It is a word of trust. Rosa Gattorno was not pessimistic with her Daughters. Being a Mother, she profoundly believes in them. Therefore, except cases, she gives joy and optimism to them showing the ideal image of the community of communion that they go building she outlines its basic points of reference:

“They will love one another with one heart and they will always compare themselves with their Bridegroom Jesus, they look at Him as the model whom they want to imitate. It is understood that they must practice the evangelical charity of our Redeemer and the dear and holy humility.”

She gave this precise orientation as a fundamental and primary teaching to the first group of the Daughters – the community in Cento, this community had Sr. Francesca Camisa as superior in July 1887 a few months after it was established. In the same letter, after having expressed the demands and the finality of the Vocation, she again reemphasized the originality of the spirit of the Institute; she said that the Daughters should remember:

“To imitate often the charity shown by your Mother St. Anne… you must love one another with one heart, you must see in this person a reflection of Jesus, an image of your Bridegroom. If He Himself orders you to do your work, do you refuse to obey Him?”

The Daughters of St. Anne live according to the demands made by fraternal charity in their loyalty to their Vows and they orient their lives, their talents, and their service of charity, through the mediation of their superior.

Mother and Teacher of Holiness.

In few years from 1866 to 1872, Rosa Gattorno established six communities that were staffed by a considerable number of nuns. Her life was filled by a spirit of dedication, since the very beginning of foundation of the new Religious Order. She was always filled by a missionary spirit of itinerancy:

“Continually travelling now for certain new communities, then for asking for money, to be able to financially assist the Sisters.”188

In such extraordinary activity, she practiced what she contemplated and she prayed and she also fulfilled God’s plan in doing His work. From God she gained lights and strength to know and to carry out his will in the development of the new religious Family that she has to serve through the Daughters of St. Anne and her Daughters. In order to fulfil that love for God and for her brothers and sisters:

“I don’t have any other reason of living this way of life.” 189

To edify the community of St. Anne, within God’s plan means to form each Daughter as a Living Stone, who draws strength, maturity and stability from Christ; to nourish all their radical possibilities; allow to be built together, with her Daughters by Christ. Making visible the maternal tenderness of the Father made mercy towards all of His Creatures. Therefore, this edification is a Divine work. She is only the poor and humble instrument of God’s will. From the Father, she accepted herself as a free gift of the Father and offered herself to the Daughters. Her words are enlightenment, fire and life challenging her Daughters to imitate her positive example190 being words that he receives from her Crucified Good Lord. When she has to give a talk to the Daughters of St. Anne she adopted an attitude of profound listening:

“Your ignorant servant must speak and deal about perfection, you my Beloved Teacher suggest so that I may repeat it… I feel as if he come close to me, He tells me quotations from the Holy Scriptures, He suggests what I never knew before, He also suggests many other wonderful things that I should say; At times I enjoy what I say others I don’t, I speak as in third person and I don’t understand what I says; finally, what a great mercy of God! He knows the needs of His creatures; He speaks through the mouth of a donkey.” 191

Her words expressed a real experience of communication with God, and they are proved by the witness of her good example in the daily life, in the most humble circumstances as in the most difficult events in the climate of relationships within the Family, marked by greatest trust, cordially and simplicity. The pedagogy of Rosa Gattorno is experiential. Her work, in the formation of the Daughters of St. Anne, is not based on a systematic spiritual doctrine. The pedagogy is developed from her life that was an Exodus, which led to its destination. The pedagogy of development from a personal reality marked by motherhood had a profound impact on her being and actions. And she dedicated her life in the fullest possible measure that she could reach to the intimate warmth of vital human relationships.

4.4.1. The following of Christ the way of love in poverty, Chastity, obedience

“Come with me to Calvary” On Calvary the fullness of Christ’s dedication to the Father is fully revealed, in the extreme giving of Himself in the sacrifice for the sake of love, there is the unlimited love of the Father, that is concentrated in mercy and in kindness, a love that assumes in the Son the poverty of the children whom the Father calls to follow Him by offering His redeeming love to all of them. Calvary is Mother Rosa’s sure place of a redeeming rest, of accomplishment. M. Rosa led her Daughters to Calvary by departing from the opposite point of the mystery of Christ: the Incarnation. By encouraging them to worship and to contemplate the mystery of Christ, she guides them along this journey in their being with Christ in the following of becoming one; to follow Christ by dedicating oneself to the service and gift of charity towards one’s brothers; to be with Him in a vital and intimate communion; to search for him, because He loves us and He’s the first who wants us. He Himself becomes little within the reach of our own stature, to encourage us with His love:

“A God who has become a little child and who nourishes Himself from His mother’s breasts (what a great tenderness of maternal memories is contained in this image!)” 192

“My dear, the day of unspeakable great mystery of love (Christmas) is coming and (Jesus) gives everything to us so that we may understand, feel, and learn to love and nourish ourselves with this very authentic love. This wonderful sign for us to show the way where we must go to drink this tasty milk: Here is a God who has become little and who nourishes Himself at His Mother’s breasts, having renounced His power for His pure love making Himself into the most humble and poor child…

You the king of heaven and earth, you are born with only a handful of straw and a little linen cloth, you had only the breath of two animals to warm you, My dear, here you may find points for meditation and consideration in the way our God has accomplish his plan. First: He has left everything. He says: Therefore, if you wish to find me, you must abandon every affection and complacency, and you must only immerse yourself in a sea that may satisfy all your wishes, this is a source that will quench your thirst, it does not matter how much thirst you may feel. God is a rich source and He will give you His riches that no one else can give to you, His word is eternal, he is powerful and full of wisdom.

Even though you may be powerful in this world, which is made of mud and poverty, He is more powerful than any person. Look at Him; He does not have shelter; therefore, to go to Him and to receive wealth from Him, it is necessary to be deprived, naked and poor without any material possessions. If we approach Him in this way He will clothe us with beautiful clothes adorned with precious stones.

My dear, it is also true that all these things are very repugnant to our humanity because we feel deprived of our sensual tastes and we are reduced to nothing by the sensitive feelings. But what a great consolation I would have if you decide to keep yourselves indifferent to everything and to seek only the will of your Bridegroom Jesus.

Therefore my Daughters, Ah! Be brave so that you may fight against the pathetic powers of the senses and of the flesh, and to wish at any cost that our spirit may be victorious and let us try to satisfy every expectation, that our Lord has for us, often we reject them as if they are trivial; One day God will ask us to give an account of them. Woe to the persons who have become deaf to the inspirations that God through His mercy gives to them!”

“If instead we listen to Him and if we always act for Him alone, He is so pleased with us, that He is enchanted with us. Oh! Blessed be that soul that succeeds in inducing the Beloved to be enchanted, the Eternal Being of all souls, the Eternal Father who knows everything: two married persons who are in love with one another. Other thought is not in them then seeking to do everything that the beloved desires. The Bride will please the Beloved Jesus doing everything for Him and receiving every cross trying to relieve Him from the burden of the crosses that evil people have placed on His shoulders. And what will this Sovereign Bridegroom do for His beloved! What precious stones of great value will these gifts be! What wonderful, sweet and gracious gifts!” 193

In outlining to the Daughters the way of living in perfection M. Rosa – we have already observed this - is precise and demanding but she also understands.

In her heart, she has welcomed the Lord; she creates enough space for a peaceful and warm welcome for the Daughters and involves them in living the gift with greater determination and fullness. M. Rosa sent this advice to Sr. Giovanna Bixio, one of her first five companions in Piacenza:

“When you are worried (agitated anxious) call Jesus to help you and you will see that He will console you. Go near the Altar, and you will say this: I intend to be united in prayer with my Mother Rosa and you will ask Him to satisfy your needs. If you become ill in body, ask Him for health; if you become spiritually ill, tell Him that you wish to love Him and with humility, pray that He will come into your heart to bring peace and unity with God, love for your brothers and sisters and charity, also obedience to the superiors and tell Him that at the cost of your life you wish to be His faithful Bride and His Lover and you wish to become a perfect nun… you wish to obey blindly… to tolerate all annoyances… to feel compassion towards everyone…to always concentrate your thoughts on God and to see everything from His point of view… to do with dedication everything that we are ordered to do.”194

In these Letters of the spiritual direction of M. Rosa the main element is always love of God. To accept this love is to allow oneself to be guided as children, to trust in Him in everything. The Daughters seek in the reality of everyday life the expression of His will so that they may follow it please Him and be His joy. To do the will of God and to obey, is the most certain evidence of loving and is the most tangible fulfilment of the following of Christ who has become a Servant, obedient even to the point of dying on the Cross. If we wish to walk with Jesus, we must act like Jesus.

The love expressed in obedience is the most certain way to make us saints, to lead us to the summit of Mount Carmel and to the love of identifying oneself with the Crucified Christ, in the participation of Christ’s paschal mystery.

M. Rosa expressed her thoughts in this way: in an instruction to the community of Sampierdarena on 7th April 1872. She observes that not all the Sisters are strong and brave in following the Christian way, in practising the virtue of humility and the virtue of obedience; not all the Sisters follow Christ closely in the way of obedience and of love.

There are three methods of following the Christian way; three ways, that can lead to different results. The first way is filled with tribulations, thorns, hedges, failures, humiliations and denial of one’s own will. The first way leads to acquire the spirit of Jesus, to humility, meekness, obedience, and total abandonment to the Supreme Lord. The second way is less difficult to follow; this way also has obstacles along the itinerary. However, streams of water refresh one’s soul and flowers bloom along the path. It leads to humility, to meekness and a decrease in one’s own will. The third way is pleasant, broad, without obstacles, and roses are flourishing along the path and even the thorns of the roses are sweet, it is the way that is followed by lukewarm virgins who do not wish to be excessively pricked.”

The conditions to follow Jesus

The way of love is not easy to follow. To walk fast without losing one’s orientation, is necessary to fight effectively and to wish that the spirit should always be victorious at any cost. It is clear that this is a way of ascending with precise conditions. First of all humility, it is necessary to look honestly at one’s own life, at the world, at God and live without superficiality with a brave determination, allowing oneself to be guided by God with absolute trust:

“Humility is the only way to avoid falling into sin and the only way to become holy.”195

“My Daughters, let us consider that we have the example of Holy Humility: Jesus. And the church keeps us busy during these days (of Lent), by teaching us the way of imitating this example of every virtue, beginning with the coming to the Jordan. What a great example of self-denial! The perfect, the most pure God-man wished to submit to be equal to the sinners who were baptized in the Jordan; but heaven opened and a voice that could not be silenced shouted: this is my Son! Jesus what are you doing? Enough you have done enough: He submits His delicate humanity to greater torments.” 196

The way of love towards the only Centre that is God requires decision and resolution: God alone is one’s priority. This aim demands to overcome every uncertainty, laziness, hesitation, to overcome the internal difficulties of human nature and also the external difficulties. So that the Daughters may follow effectively the Christian way, the Mother enrols them as students in the school of Jesus, to become apprentices of that art requires a fundamental commitment, an everyday dedication in the ascent that consists of vigilance, acceptance of daily difficulties, it means to spiritually die to the worldly concerns, it is sacrifice, is loneliness. In one word it is the Cross of Jesus, the treasure whom the world does not know. To be marked with the sign of Jesus, means to live the love of Jesus every day with loyalty: the Sisters must make themselves little to run towards Jesus. They must beg Him so that, “he may make them spiritually beautiful.” In this awareness is our strength, our courage; this awareness sustains our loyalty.

“Always have courage and strong perseverance, and you will succeed with God’s help…Let us run to the Teacher, to learn everything and we must do this precisely with the innocence of children…Look at Peter! Come, the teacher told Him, and Peter without considering that he had a family or other commitments immediately went.

This also happened to all those who followed the Saviour. Of course this Teacher did not go on tourist trips or to pleasant parties, instead was willing to accept everything without worrying about anything such as food, or clothes, he was too busy in seeking the lost sheep. Together with the Apostles and with Jesus they went with him to suffer hunger and thirst. The Teacher said: Those who wish to follow me (He showed a cross to us) must make their cross and follow me.

So what kind of language is this? Heavenly Bridegroom! Oh! Blessed souls! He gives this treasure to me, a treasure that the world does not know or accept. He also offers it to His beloved Brides… because this treasure is hard to bear at beginning, one must never stop even at the cost of dragging the Cross. Then Jesus becomes compassionate and he helps us to carry it…

Often not only does the cross fall, but we who carry it also fall, but what must we do? Let us be brave! We all feel disadvantaged and discouraged because of our littleness we feel ragged, trembling, we don’t know how to call the bridegroom any longer. He is completely handsome while we are deformed.

What must we do? Let us be humble and call Him, to help us as Father of mercy and of love, and with words that are full of repentance, let us adorn us, so that we may not become deformed and be sent away by the Bridegroom. Ah! How happy this Lord of love is, that we should treat Him not as some souls treat Him they believe that He is a tyrant. If He allows this, he does in order to humiliate us even more, and to make us grateful in the Father’s eyes.” 197

She wishes her Daughters to be perfect imitators of Christ, with clothes that are varnished and adorned by His Blood, because Jesus wishes them to be completely His, He want to grow in them:

“By giving them His food and by strengthening them with the precious wine of His Blood. From this, He wishes that we live in this life and reach His presence with the purple robe of His very Divine Blood, dyed with His Blood. And we may not wear this purple robe, if we are not crucified; the Cross is the nuptial bed for his brides.198

She sent this message to Sr. Francesca Camisa:

“God wishes that you follow His way, the same way that He wishes His Beloved to be on… it is a dark way, and full of tribulations and sorrows but you know what He does when they eventually find the correct destination? He allows them to become drunk with his wine, His delicious wine at the point that they forget themselves and in their sorrows they run along this way with a great desire to know God.

They feel the thorns but the pricks are sweet. They feel the pain in their chest and this change into a loving impulse and into loving thoughts. All this happens because they don’t feel anything now they don’t hear anything except a fiery impulse of love that drags them to look for the Beloved and if will be necessary to go down into the abyss of hell to find him and they would endure terrible sufferings and even there they would not suffer, because that Being makes everything sweet, he is the nectar that is contained inside the sharpest thorns.” 199

4.4.2. The law of love: the Cross

In the documents that are quoted here, the spiritual progress achieved by Rosa Gattorno is clearly explained. She has achieved the life-changing union with her “Good Crucified Lord.” In her teaching even taking into account the objective reality of the Daughters, there cannot be any separation from the spiritual fervour of her mystical experience. From intensive unity with God the Trinity, the irresistible force of the Charism of her motherhood is unleashed: as life to be donated. Her life is Christ her Good Lord. His love has conquered her:

“My Jesus, heart of Jesus, Love of Jesus, Hope of Jesus, language of Jesus… Jesus for me… I live for Him!” 200

She only speaks about Jesus, who is everything in her life.

“I would like to say a hundred things and speak to you about the dear Lord of Love. My Daughter, love everyone for charity’s sake and keep your love for this Being. In all matters, without taking your love away from Him; do everything for him, yes, everything.” 201

Of this Dear Lord of Love, she has discovered the mysterious and terrible choice that he made: the Cross. The Cross is the only way to Holiness, the most sublime way; and her Daughters must not fear the sorrows of the Cross. She implores her Good Lord, that her Daughters may embrace the Cross and that his nectar may inebriate them, which purify the suffering for the sake of love. To be with Jesus, one must accept as Jesus did the Cross of Redemption.

“Oh! If my dear Crucified Lord will grant my request, the love of God will certainly consume you. Love! Love! It is your only help in all your sorrows and tribulations and you live only for Him. May God help you to become as I wish you to be.”202

She participated in the Cross with an increasing intensity. Every day there is a flood of crosses. And the irresistible power of love is enriched. And she goes towards her Daughters and everyone else in the dynamism of a vital mission with the wealth of the natural gifts of femininity, which flourishes in the motherhood that is sublimated in the spirit.

Mother Rosa proclaims the wonders of God like Mary the first Daughter of St. Anne did. She wishes to proclaim to everyone with a loud voice that in love is the only good. The heart that is empty and free is inhabited by the Being who:

“Make us, poor creatures of God. We can say God in the creatures, one being with the Creator.” 203

The creatures become a vacuum where Christ offers the gifts of the Holy Spirit:

“Love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, loyalty, meekness and self-control”204

To accept the gift of the Spirit is the intimacy of a continual life of prayer that involves everything: soul, body, spirit and become a desire, an inspiration to be for Jesus, with Jesus and in Jesus:

“To live for Him to die for Him; A brief period of suffering, to gain eternal joy.”

4.4.3. The requirement of love

As an expert spiritual teacher, the Mother does not limit her work of showing to the Daughters the joys of true holiness. At the summit of Calvary, the peak of love and bridal gift, one arrives by passing through the stations of the way of the Cross (via Crucis). To walk effectively along the way, and not deviate, getting lost, losing courage, and being afraid, one needs the right means. M. Rosa explains these means with the tenderness of a Mother, deriving them not from reading ascetic books but from her own life. This confers effectiveness and also strength of conviction and actualization.

Concentrating the heart of God

“We must only have one objective that must occupy our thought, our heart; the only objective of our life is God alone. We must live for Him, for Him to be crucified. Daughter of what use is the whole world, if we don’t have God? Nothing, and less than nothing.”205

“Dear Daughter, love Jesus and always keep Him very close to your heart. During the day, lower your head towards your heart, and tell Jesus who is hidden in it: My Love, My Lord, I wish to be completely yours, and I wish that you should be completely mine, Dear Jesus. Other times you may say: Oh! My Beloved, what are you doing inside my heart, are you alone inside this small house? Oh! Speak to me and calm my doubts, confirm my love for you! Jesus my Saviour, give me your love.”206

To live in bridal intimacy, to believe in love, to allow one self to be guided by love, to always seek the only objective of our life. M. Rosa guides her Daughters towards the summit. At the summit, each Daughter must try to be effectively perfect nun in their loyalty to all means that the Family of the Holy Mother offers. The main means are: prayer and silence, observance of the Rule and sacrifice.

“Often remind yourselves why you have become nuns: to become holy and gradually to acquire God’s love… you must reach this divine love.”207

Prayer and silence

It is important to pray, to always pray. One must fill one’s life with prayer, continually speaking to the Lord, seeking Him in one’s own heart and in one’s brothers and sister.

“Be brave, my Daughters, pray always and meditate a lot, because you always have a means of meditation by seeing Jesus in those who are sick, therefore, you will succeed in meditating on the Passion of Jesus.” 208

“The prayers make our life fruitful of good works, enrich our actions and our good deeds, attract the pleasure of the Lord and the wonderful joy of being favoured by God.”209

Prayer is spiritual richness.

“Prayer is the key to all graces; it opens the treasure of the Lord.” 210

“I don’t have any other treasure except prayer; from prayer I obtain everything and with prayer, I obtain the courage and the hope that I need and one day we will find that our good works at the throne of God our judge, these works will defend us and save us from being thrown into hell as we deserve to be.” 211

Prayer is central to the Christian life.

“Be careful, my Daughters in joy, in sorrow, in tribulations, in your good work always rely on prayer.”212

“Daughter, if you are sad, run to the church and expose your problems to Jesus. Then weep and dry your tears, go back again at work, to help everyone and full of positive feelings in others.” 213

To pray is to listen to the Beloved.

“If we all work on the task that God has given to us and if in our hearts we have formed a lonely house and if we only think about loving and serving the Good Lord, how good this would be… Oh! It will be good because everything else could not hurt us, instead we could concentrate on listening to His voice that is heard when one is alone. You are blessed my Daughters because you may leave your work and go to your private chamber.214

Living the virtues of the Family of the Holy Mother in this climate of uninterrupted and faithful prayer, in the searching and discerning what pleases to the Father, is formed the true identity of the Daughters of St. Anne.

The Rule of 1869, expressed the dynamism that is articulated in the seven typical Virtues of the Family of the Holy Mother: faith, hope, charity, simplicity, and prudence, humility and meekness.

Mother Rosa has recognized in the Rules, of 1869, the authentic interpretation of the charism, and considers the Rules to be a code of life, for herself and for her Daughters; she wishes that the Rules should be learnt, and that the Daughters should faithfully obey them.

“The rules must be learnt in their hearts and minds; they must be obeyed in faithfulness.”215

In the Rules, is the treasure, the patrimony, the solid foundation that the Daughters of St Anne uses to edify herself, according to the spirit, and she becomes the beloved of God.

“…For these Daughters, who are the consolation of the Holy Mother, I feel a great love and I look at them with joy and love, as my Mother St Anna, looks at them!”216

Faith, Hope, charity, that are as three dimensions of living in communion with God that every Christian must have, are lived by the Daughters of St Anna, in the original spirit of the charism of Foundation. They are gifts for a mission.

These gifts make the Daughters a living temple of the heart, a true land of Christ, from the roots of their womanhood; their destiny is to participate in the motherhood of God.

“My Daughter… You need a strong faith to believe that to become united with God, and that help him, in one can say, in the most important work he does in this world that is precisely in helping the people in body and in spirit, so that they may become beatified in heaven and that He may give to you in this commitment his Holy Spirit, his Providence, his mercy with which he helps the person.”

“You need the heavenly hope that allows you to live as a child in the Father’s arms and the charity that is like the soul of these two virtues. The charity that is inflamed by the pure love of God is really the heavenly fire that fertilized my womb so that I was able to worthily conceive my Daughter Mary. Charity consists of this: that you seek only the approval of God, as Jesus has taught us; to do what pleases the Father, I always do what pleases Him.” 217

The Mother integrates these “sublime teachings” this is her own expression, into daily life with a strong human and spiritual strength, obtained from living intelligence of spiritual subjects and in the penetration of the way of thinking of God. She advises Sr. Francesca Camisa:

“Come back to your peace, consider that your poor Mother always keeps you close to her for, she wishes that the Holy Mother may make you holy; she says to the Father, make this creature a true reflection of your will so that she may experience the joy of serving you, our Father, our strength and our guide.” 218

To another nun Sr. Adelaide Pezzoni, she wrote:

“Let us bless the Lord, our helper, our teacher, who knows so well how to teach us, let us try to profit from his lessons and to be attentive how we may please Him and fully satisfy His will. My Daughter if you knew what great consolation I experience just by saying these words (to please God) and these words revive even more in me the sweet thought that I may become his servant, that I feel overwhelmed by joy and even if I had to experience the most cruel martyrdom I would not feel any sorrow.219

“My Daughter, be brave. Be patient, soon you will see that the Lord will come with a special providence… oh, don’t lack trust in God the Father. Let us pray with fervour, so that our prayers may reach the loving heart of Jesus where there is the source of every temporal and spiritual wealth. We must practice the Holy Rules because the Rules are another very powerful means to please the Eternal Father.

Dear hand of God it heals our wounds whenever it touches; Daughter, love this Eternal Father and help your Daughters to love Him because if they will love this Father and God who is our only Good Lord, they will become perfect and will be able to do everything they wish to do and everything will be done well. I dedicate a thought to everyone: my blessed Daughters stand firm and feel confident in God’s help… Love your privations, and happily offer them to your Eternal Father, so that he may deign to accept them and to change them into petty treasure; what a delight my Daughters is to think that for such petty sorrows, you will receive a great deal of good and your heart will start feeling the joy of love of the Beloved Lord.”220

Rules of 1869:

Simplicity and prudence

“My Daughter… in me the Word of Jesus Christ was fulfilled, that God is pleased to reveal his secrets to the simple… Because in me was revealed the most wonderful act of the Immaculate Conception of Mary… My Daughter, imitate me and be attentive that there is no hypocrisy, everything in you may be light…in all your actions search only your treasure that is to please your God only then he will intimately converse with you.

My Daughter, Simplicity cannot live without the company of Prudence. Prudence is the light that allows you to choose between two things, the one that better leads you to increase your only wealth, that is the love of God… When you work, always consider what gives more glory to God and the best interests of your fellow brothers and sisters… My Daughter I had so much prudence that I was worthy to conceive the Woman who is the Most Prudent Virgin. You must follow my example, and by doing this you will become as simple as a dove and as prudent as a snake.”

Humility and meekness

“My Daughter you see that I am placed by God on the throne of most high dignity, of being the Mother of Divine Mother… therefore, this means that I was after Mary, the most humble person, because humility is the way of exaltation that comes from God… The one who is humble, my Daughter has the words of Jesus Christ deeply engraved in her soul: the one, who wishes to be the leader among you, must become everyone’s servant. You are blessed if you inherit this virtue, you will always live in peace and joy.

“Blessed are the meek because they will inherit the earth.” …Human nature in the person of a woman is that earth that was created by God, because He wished to cultivate fruits of blessing. I received this blessing, because I conceived the Person who is the only Immaculate. My flesh was really a holy land. Mary was the new earth, from which by the work of the Holy Spirit, conceived Jesus Christ, who is the fruit of the real science of good and evil… Mary was my wealth, therefore, if I deserve to receive this gift from the Father of the family. It is because I offered to her a meekness that is not equalled by any person. Therefore, you would not be my worthy Daughter, if you are not distinguished by this virtue.” 221

Mother Rosa says

“Dear Daughters of St Anne, May God bless you and when you speak may the truth always be on your lips and simplicity in your heart.”222

“Jesus the delight of good and honest souls, you are the truth and the life, you love those who seek the truth, allow Carolina to be a true dove, help her to imitate you when she speaks.”223

To the same nun:

“… Your poor Mother never forgets her child. Jesus loves children very much, but do you know what type of children he loves more? Those who are simple, humble that are too young to develop the monster of pride, which is precisely present in older persons. The Virgin Mary also love the doves, she loves them very much because in them pride has not yet developed nor does vainglory;224

“My Daughter every time that you will have to speak, never think too much, or take too much care about what you must say in reply by using your intelligence. No, don’t do this; present yourself to everyone without prior planning what to say, use only charity and kindness, without affectation and with simplicity, and always be united with God in His presence; and then speak without fear and you will say everything well. Oh, Sweet Jesus! Those who love you know how to speak well! Therefore, love and then do what you wish and you will do everything well.”225

“Dear Daughters of St. Anne, humility is the only secure base for becoming holy; without it we may never hope to have Eternal Life. It is written: if you want to enter heaven, you must become little and humble, the Lord said to a soul: Don’t worry about your destiny, just trust me and you will have everything, therefore, think about belonging completely to Jesus, because Jesus always gives to you what you need. Oh! You are blessed if He gives his love to you… this love certainly can’t be received without humility.”226

“Concerning the Daughters who have left, I believe that they should be readmitted, because Jesus wishes us to do this. How many are the sinners who fall and who return to Him and are welcomed with mercy? Therefore take them back as I know that God will always be pleased with all our actions, which are done against our bad will, but only for His Love. Let us love Him in our sisters and let us love them.”227

“Jesus is completely patient and meek; He is also charity and love. Our mother St. Anne also had these virtues.”228

“My Daughter, I advice you to be meek, because this is the true character of a Daughter of St. Anne mother of the Immaculate. If we must imitate the Holy Mother, this is how we need to be, on the contrary we are not real Daughters of St. Anne. If we don’t follow the good example we are reprobates.” 229

“Peace, silence, meekness, and then you will hear God, who will speak to your heart, with words of love and sweetness.” 230

”Believe me dear Daughter that kindness is powerful weapon for winning hearts and for leading them to love Jesus. It is also the necessary virtue that maintains a positive climate in a community, spreading its pleasant way in the persons who join a community, I believe that we are the poor Daughters of St. Anne, mother of the Immaculate, more than everyone else must have this virtue. I say this because we are in continual contact with persons from outside our Family and these persons may get a positive opinion about our Family by our speaking and by our behaviour. Our behaviour must be humble and it must be a consolation for God. How good it is to see a nun who speaks pleasantly with humility, modesty and who is modest in her behaviour with visitors. It is easy for us to disguise all our sorrows and to allow outsiders always to see us as pleasant persons. It is good to manifest outsiders that our religious spirit is a great spiritual comfort for all souls.” 231

4.5 Mother, Educator and superior of the daughters

In her human motherhood, Rosa Gattorno had practised all the richness of her being in the gift of life. In her spiritual motherhood, that is an important gift from her Good Lord of love, the maternal unconditionally dedication drew nourishment from the endless resources of the infinite Being, she felt God possessing her soul and she proclaims herself to be as Mary the most humble servant of God. It is a spiritual motherhood that is born from God for the sake of the kingdom, to flourish and to produce positive fruit in his Vineyard and in His Work. She served, developed and strengthened the life that was entrusted to her fulfilling God’s plan. Her dedication is for everyone. As it does not belong to her, it belongs entirely to her Good Lord, the wealth of the gift of creation and salvation that she has received from the patrimony of her Daughters of St Anne. Each Daughter, like M. Rosa is called to work generously for the Work of God, working the piece of land that God has given to her to cultivate232 in the specific task assigned to her by obedience, for each of them, she gave all her love and attention because in each Daughter, she loves to see the outline of the true Daughter of St. Anne.

She dedicated a very special care to the formation of the Superiors; to them she entrusted the very delicate task of guiding the Sisters in the way of holiness, in their loyalty to the spirit of the Institute. She worked tirelessly, offering herself as a guide to them in order to be able to do this task effectively. Her first followers were very young almost all of them were approximately 20 years old.233

They shared the same ideal of Mother Rosa; they were able to live in harmony with the foundation plan by expressing the Charism in tangible forms. From among them, she chooses the Superiors not on the criteria of age, but rather on the discernment of the Spirit. The Spirit is the only dispenser of gifts and the one who perfect all the gifts. She takes care of them as if with tender plants with respect and delicacy. She realizes their inexperience and the importance of the responsibility of a community. “My Daughter Adelaide even though so young, is the mother of many Daughters”234 She watches over them with optimism, encouraging them in moments of discouragement, so that they may stop looking at their littleness and their incapacity to concentrate on God who calls them to do great work.

The Daughters are open with her; they confide to her their doubts, worries and sorrows, they ask her advice and directions. The Mother gives to each nun the correct answer directly, or by letter quickly. Sr. Adelaide Pezzoni, who had been the Principal and teacher in the community at Sampierdarena, now that she is the Superior in Piacenza, she believes that the task of an educator is better suited to her abilities. To work as a Superior is a heavy burden. The Mother replies to her with the usual advice of love and spirituality:

“My Daughter for ever, in reading your letter, I could not think peacefully: how can Sr. Maria Adelaide have silly thoughts? No, this is all the work of the devil. She is not yet an expert in this Career, she always allows herself to be defeated by sadness, let us then unmask the liar. My Daughter:

  1. Look at where you are, where God has placed you. Look at the very broad and beautiful garden of the Saviour who is the Gardener, look at how he raised you to sublime greatness, to be an active participant in his new Order, that is born in the womb of his beloved Bride, of whom one day we will know the full extension, goodness and its power and those who work in the Order gain eternal life. We will see all this in glory of the Blessed, where we must hope to go, because of God’s pure mercy. It is in Heaven that events are seen so clearly and the faulty reasoning of the world is ended.

  2. You wish to dedicate yourself to the education of the girls. Well, what must we say if the Lord wishes you to be more completely His, in a greater and more demanding condition? What do you wish to do? Do you prefer the world –how it will be horrible! – or to submit to the service of an infinite Being, a Master who does not know how to rule, because He love us too much and His orders are all love. He makes Himself a Father to teach us, He makes Himself a Bridegroom to give everything to us. You say that you are idle. How? I say therefore do you mind helping your poor Mother to carry the burden that she has on her back? What are these words of love, that consideration wish to relieve so many sorrows? Therefore, my Daughter, are these only superficial words? No, they are not. My Sr. Adelaide can’t be a hypocrite.”235

To the same person:

“ …I would like my Delegate, during this time to really work as a mother and as a wise, prudent, strong, constant and patient mother in carrying the heavy Cross that her Jesus carried on His shoulder. Ah! Daughter, if you carry it with patience you will enter into that beautiful Paradise that Jesus made especially for the Superiors who are mirrors and models of virtues for their communities. Consider that everyone is watching you and if they see works of holiness, will they not desire to imitate her? And by your example, all the Daughters will become holy, and God will give to you a wonderful place that will be of greater glory above everyone else’s and in the beatitude of seeing so many souls praising God for your cooperation, you will rejoice in God’s joy” 236

M. Rosa is very strong in her certainty of being close to the infinite Being, whose order is all love; she strengthens the hesitation of the Daughters. If Jesus places on their shoulders the cross of being Superior, He does not leave them to carry it with their own strength alone. She believes that this is a gift given in docility and in listening to God’s teaching. The Holy Mother is close to all her Daughters as a vigilant guide, and a tender Mother.

“Why are you so timorous about the position that you have received? No you must be peaceful and full of trust in God. Speak to the Holy Mother, she is always with you to suggest what you must say and do. We are only saws in the hands of the blacksmith237.

Be brave and full of love for Jesus and for the Holy mother St. Anne.” The Lord God and the tender Mother St. Anne will hold your hand and the work of your delicate leadership will be blessed.” 238

Therefore why should one be afraid? We are not able to do anything without God’s help and with His help we have everything.” 239

Letters like these reveal the strong character of such a Mother, her fascination, her force of persuasion, her ability to educate, that develops qualities and attitudes in her Daughter, clarifies and strengthens their conscience in the total belonging to God in His Work. She is close to the Superiors, not only during the early years of the Institute but always. Till the few months before she died, she continued to write re-emphasizing the principles that inspire a good administration of the communities. Some written evidence from the many Letters to the Superiors along the course of her life, outline the image of the Superior seen with her heart and through the perspective of the charism.

“The Superior of the houses must act as mothers for the nuns, so that the nuns who have left their mothers and their families will find in her maternal affection that gains their significant confidence.”240

“Superior, you must treat your Daughters with the love of a mother.”241 “Make sure that you are a mother of these nuns and children.”242

“The Superior is the one who with good manners, may deviate her Daughters from every evil inclination and direct them to the correct path of holiness and perfection and of having them with her in heaven for the whole eternity of happiness.”243

The Superior must know how to educate the nuns.

“They are like plants, which die without being fertilized, and we must try to pour nourishing water on them, the water that our Lord Jesus described to the Samaritan woman. Therefore, the Superior must try to do everything so that her Sisters will drink plenty of that water; consequently the meditation must be done properly and in the Chapel, prayers must also be recited in the Chapel and frequent meetings must be held and the Superiors must make positive exhortation to the nuns.”244

The Superior is an expression of the living Rule.

“I advice you to observe the Rule; you must be the first in everything, so that you will do a great deal of good work because you will regularly be firm in holding prayer and meditation. Those who do this well are certain to observe the other things.” 245

“The Superior must be the beacon who guides everyone towards the safe harbour.”

“For goodness’s sake…. Follow the Rule… the Recollection Day must be done in silence and read the Rules, so that the Sisters may memorize them and you may always be guided in everything by the holy words of our Rules; then you will never lack providence; Always pray well and with fervour.”246

“Patience, meekness, resignation are the virtues that God requires the superior to have. Are you sad? Then run into the church and cry out to Jesus. Weep, and once dried up your tears go back to your work, dedicate yourself completely to everyone, full of kind feelings in others.”247

To her secretary whom she sent to a community, so that she could stay for a certain period to help and guide the local Superior she advised:

“Be kind with the Sisters and love them because they are religious ladies who are equal to the Superior, and we are all equal; for goodness’s sake, be careful, don’t strain them but treat them with charity and with love.” 248

To the Superior, Sr. Paola Bucciotti, she sent by mail other valuable advice:

“We must not develop any preference in relationship with the Sisters, neither spiritual nor temporal, so that the Sisters may imitate us not in the extraordinary, but rather in the precise observance of the Rules.”249

One becomes a model and a centre of fraternal unity by assuming the same sentiments that Jesus Christ has. He has renewed us in love and in peace, taking sin away with His death, surrendering Himself to the extreme prostration. Therefore, the superiors’ fundamental virtue is humility.

“Consider that humility is the base of every virtue and those who have humility have God. Yes my Daughter, learn this wonderful practice of humility and you will have everything from the Lord, your house will be jewel in the sight of your Crucified Lord and you will be His beloved, for your courage; therefore one needs to be violent to gain the treasures of heaven.” 250

The Superior, who has the sentiments of Christ, performs a service of love to her Sisters with the attitude of the Holy Mother, whose heart was full of mercy.

“Charity does not have limits! Oh, love; you are the outcome of charity! What should I say about your letter? If you live in complete charity you will feel great sorrow for the young sister who is oppressed by work and who complains. Oh! Poor humanity, what bitter fruits do you produce? Therefore, I have absolutely forbidden the teacher to teach during the school holidays. No, no, she has an absolute need to rest before she begins to teach again, because teaching is a tiring work. Therefore if she is still teaching, she should stop her work immediately and rest and the others should also rest. All teachers have an absolute need to rest. We understand one another, don’t we? If the administrators have something to say about this then they will write to me and I will reply to them. Have you understood? Goodbye, believe that I am yours for all eternity, yours affectionately, M. Rosa.”251

The lesson of the Superior was beneficial:

“To be living in complete charity. Charity does not have limits because it is measured according to the standards of the Teacher who gives Himself to us as our nourishment.” 252 “

“Be charitable and kind to your fellow Sisters if you wish to conquer their hearts and to become a saint with them.” 253

“Exercise great prudence, Charity, Humility, Kindness, towards everyone: your Sisters and towards other persons that you meet and you will conquer the hearts of all in giving their hearts to the Lord.”254

The Superior as a good mother of a family is attentive, untiring, vigilant, and careful about everything, to make sure that there is order, harmony and vigilance.

“Listen, I recommend order and vigilance, so that the least important part of the good order I have left, should not be destroyed.”255

“That attention must be given to everyone, to the school the spinning mill, the kitchen, be all fire of attentiveness, you should always walk around to make sure that all the Sisters do their duty. I advice you to clean the dormitories, make sure that the young girls are clean, don’t forget to look after the wardrobe and the store.”256

“Fire of anxiety” is the solicitude of love that makes the Superior the guide and the coordinator of everyone’s energies, because one heart alone and one soul alone may give themselves without tiring to the work of the Lord.

“I recommend the daily economy, this means being careful about spending cents, that in time multiply themselves into 100 francs.
